dialogues.speaker: Uncle Luo
dialogues.text: Is it just that the soil here has lost its fertility? Or has the weather just not been favorable? Either way, the tea doesn't have the same flavor as the previous harvests.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Luo
dialogues.text: And since the problem lies with the tea, no amount of additional processing will help. We have to serve it to the adeptus soon. Ohh, what shall we do?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Luo
dialogues.text: ...And those visiting guests and merchants. How will we deal with them?
